text: Main Courses Corporate Financial Management, Banking and Financial Market, International Finance, Human Resource Management, Operations Research, Production and Operations Management, Project Management Aim The course aims to produce graduates with good business management skills that are efficient in Asia as well as in the rest of the world. To graduate, a student must successfully earn the required number of credits in each of eight groups, and at least 140 credits in total, including those from internships and an optional applied research project. Why choose these programs The programs emphasize personal development and the acquisition of business skills to: 1. ensure that each student is challenged individually to attain the highest standards of personal excellence; 2. introduce students to some basic humanities and social science courses that help them expand their perspective, and become responsible members of civil society; 3. ensure that students learn to question assumptions and come up with creative and meaningful solutions; 4. enhance learning by hands-on projects and teamwork. After graduation, students will be awarded Bachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA).
